result.summary: The page is generally usable, but several horizontally scrolling elements are visibly clipped at the screen edges, making content look cut off; there are also minor contrast/touch-target concerns.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right edge, with an additional chip only partially visible after “Healthy.”
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade/gradient, horizontal scroll indicator, or ensure peeking content is intentional and consistently sized.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third restaurant card is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths, clearer peek behavior, or ellipsize names within fully visible cards rather than clipping mid-card.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card is cut off by the bottom of the viewport, making the page look unfinished in this state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure scroll position preserves enough bottom padding above the navigation bar, or avoid capturing partially obscured cards in QA states.

issues.description: Small green “See all” text links may be hard to tap and could be low emphasis for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase touch target size to at least 44x44pt and consider stronger weight/underline for affordance.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons overlaid on food imagery may have variable contrast depending on the photo background.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent scrim or solid circular background behind icon buttons to maintain contrast.
